readme.text: English · 中文

把 rtk 接进 DeepSeek Harness，二进制一起带上。
能改写的改写 · 改不动的压缩 · 省了多少看得见

rtk（Rust Token Killer）站在 agent 和工具之间：把命令改写成过滤版，并在模型读到工具输出之前先压一遍。官方为 20 个 agent 写了适配层，DSH 不在其中；社区已有的 DSH 插件也只补了「改写」或「裁剪」的一半。这个插件把三件事一次补齐：**改写**（委托 rtk 的规则）、**压缩**（真 rtk 方法链，不重造引擎）、**可见**（省下的 token 进统计，也在界面上一眼看到）。失败路径全部开放：rtk 缺失、超时或返回意料之外的东西时，工具调用和没装这个插件时一样。它不注册新工具、不替换 shell 执行器、不碰模型 API。

| 能力 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| **命令改写** | 开 | `git status` 以 `rtk git status` 执行，首行标 `[rtk] ran:`；语义守卫确认改写仍在跑原命令（`next build` 走 `rtk next`，丢参数的提案被拒），rtk 跑不起来时重放原命令并标 `[rtk] fell back:` |
| **输出压缩** | 开（≥ 2 KB） | `rtk hook claude` 压缩大输出，文件/搜索结果默认跳过；保留 `rtk recall <hash>`，沙箱够不到 rtk 库时原文落盘并给出路径 |
| **节省可见** | 开 | token 估算（ASCII ÷4、汉字 ×0.6）＋跨重启累计；界面药丸随时可瞥，`/rtk stats` 查明细 |
| **/rtk 命令组** | 常驻 | `status`、`stats`、`tools`、`explain`、`doctor`、`gain`、`recall`、`on/off` |

在**插件面板**里搜 `dsh-rtk-workbench` 点安装，或者：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-rtk-workbench
```

也可以直接装 GitHub Release 上的 `dsh-rtk-workbench-<platform>.tgz`。装完**重启宿主**（bundle 变更不是刷新页面）。**不需要单独安装 rtk**——平台二进制随包分发，覆盖 Windows x64、macOS x64/arm64、Linux x64/arm64；其它平台见 [参考手册](./docs/reference.zh.md)。

```
/rtk status     # 二进制、pipeline、开关、本会话省量
/rtk stats      # 完整报告；--json 给机器读
/rtk off ui     # 隐藏输入框下方的省量药丸
```

之后正常干活：大仓库里的 `git status` 变成紧凑结果；`cat` 一个 100 KB 日志会被压缩并指向 `rtk recall <hash>`，沙箱里则给出可直接读的落盘路径。`status`、`stats`、`tools`、`explain`、`doctor`、`recall` 的完整说明在参考手册。

改写靠包装 `ToolDefinition.execute`（不是重派发），保留注册表的信号融合与记账；压缩在 `tools/post-execute` 里先 `await next()` 再做内容替换，因此安全插件与 spill 策略照常生效。界面侧，宿主半提供只读 `GET /api/rtk-workbench/status`，浏览器半在输入框下方（composer 的 dock 行，与宿主的 activity/usage 同一排）显示「省 X token · ↓N%」，点开是明细浮层。

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  M["模型调用工具"] --> X[包装后的 execute]
  X -->|rtk rewrite| R{"能改写？"}
  R -->|是| E1["执行 rtk <cmd>"]
确定性基准合计 **463 507 B → 38 264 B（−91.7 %）**，约 115.9k → 9.6k 估算 token。完整表格、复现方法与「这些数字不能证明什么」见 [基准测试](./docs/benchmark.zh.md)；token 为估算值，不是服务商计费口径。

- [参考手册](./docs/reference.zh.md) —— 命令、配置、恢复、兼容矩阵、排障、设计说明
- [基准测试](./docs/benchmark.zh.md) —— 固定 fixture 的可复现数字与边界
- [兼容性台账](./docs/compatibility.zh.md) —— 已验证宿主、声明范围、`verify-host`
- [变更记录](./CHANGELOG.md) —— 每个版本改了什么

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm typecheck     # host + client 两个编译面
pnpm test
pnpm build         # lib/index.js（宿主）+ lib/client.js（浏览器）

更多脚本（`benchmark`、`release`、`check-manifest`、`check-docs`）见参考手册。
压缩规则、过滤器与 `hook` 协议都是 [rtk](https://github.com/rtk-ai/rtk) 的工作；本插件原样分发 rtk 二进制（Apache-2.0，链接 BUSL-1.1 的 `rtk-engine`，两份许可见 [`licenses/`](./licenses)）。

English · 中文

rtk wired into DeepSeek Harness, binary included.
rewrite what rtk can rewrite · compress the rest · show what it saved

rtk (Rust Token Killer) sits between the agent and its tools: it rewrites a command into a filtered form and condenses output before the model reads it. It ships adapters for twenty agents — DSH is not one of them — and the community plugins for DSH cover only half of either half. This plugin closes the loop: **rewrite** (delegated to rtk's rules), **compress** (rtk's own method chain, no reimplementation), **show** (savings land in the counters and are visible in the UI). Every failure path stays open: with rtk missing, slow or answering something unexpected, a tool call behaves exactly as if this plugin were not installed. It registers no new tool, replaces no shell executor and touches no model API.

| Capability | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| **Command rewriting** | on | `git status` runs as `rtk git status` and the result starts with `[rtk] ran:`; the semantic guard proves the rewrite still runs the original command (`next build` maps to `rtk next`, a proposal that drops an argument is refused), and a failed rewrite replays the original with `[rtk] fell back:` |
| **Output compression** | on (≥ 2 KB) | `rtk hook claude` condenses large output; file and search results are skipped by default; `rtk recall <hash>` stays available, and a sandboxed shell gets a spilled path it can read |
| **Visible savings** | on | Token estimate (ASCII ÷4, CJK ×0.6) plus cross-restart totals; the pill is there at a glance, `/rtk stats` has the detail |
| **/rtk commands** | always | `status`, `stats`, `tools`, `explain`, `doctor`, `gain`, `recall`, `on/off` |

Search `dsh-rtk-workbench` in the **plugin panel**, or:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-rtk-workbench
```

You can also install the GitHub release asset `dsh-rtk-workbench-<platform>.tgz`. **Restart the host** afterwards (a bundle change is not a page refresh). **rtk itself is not required** — platform binaries ship with the package for Windows x64, macOS x64/arm64 and Linux x64/arm64; other platforms are covered in the [reference manual](./docs/reference.md).

```
/rtk status     # binary, pipeline, switches, this session's savings
/rtk stats      # full report; --json for machines
/rtk off ui     # hide the savings pill below the composer
```

Then work as usual: `git status` in a large repository becomes a compact listing; `cat` on a 100 KB log is condensed and points at `rtk recall <hash>` — or at a spilled file the sandbox can read. `status`, `stats`, `tools`, `explain`, `doctor` and `recall` are documented in the reference manual.

Rewriting wraps `ToolDefinition.execute` (it does not re-dispatch), keeping the registry's signal fusion and accounting intact; compression runs in `tools/post-execute`, always after `await next()`, so safety plugins and the spill policy still apply. Browser side, the host half serves one read-only `GET /api/rtk-workbench/status`, and the browser half renders `saved X token · ↓N%` below the composer (in its dock row, beside the host's activity/usage pills) with a details overlay behind it.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  M["model calls a tool"] --> X["patched execute"]
  X -->|rtk rewrite| R{"rewritable?"}
  R -->|yes| E1["run rtk <cmd>"]

Deterministic benchmark total: **463 507 B → 38 264 B (−91.7 %)**, about 115.9k → 9.6k estimated tokens. The full table, how to reproduce it and what those numbers do **not** prove are in [the benchmark](./docs/benchmark.md); tokens are estimates, not provider billing.

- [Reference manual](./docs/reference.md) — commands, config, recovery, compatibility matrix, troubleshooting, design notes
- [Benchmark](./docs/benchmark.md) — reproducible fixture numbers and their limits
- [Compatibility ledger](./docs/compatibility.md) — verified hosts, declared ranges, `verify-host`
- [Changelog](./CHANGELOG.md) — what each release changed

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm typecheck     # both compiler faces: host and client
pnpm test
pnpm build         # lib/index.js (host) + lib/client.js (browser)

More scripts (`benchmark`, `release`, `check-manifest`, `check-docs`) are listed in the reference manual.

Filtering rules, filters and the `hook` protocol are [rtk](https://github.com/rtk-ai/rtk)'s work; this plugin redistributes the rtk binary unchanged (Apache-2.0, linked against the BUSL-1.1 `rtk-engine`; both license texts ship in [`licenses/`](./licenses)).
